material.acceptance_criteria: A key event without a ground point casts nothing at a made-up point: the mod refuses it with a reason, or the page omits world and the mod uses the hero position for self-centred casts.
material.description: js/client/play.js:270 sets the key's ground point to null while pointer is null (no pointermove since load), then play.js:278 sends world {x:0,z:0}. scenarios/moba/controls.lua:436 reads a.world.x and a.world.z without a sentinel check, and cast_key (:315) passes that point to cast_now at :330 for an ability with no target type. The sentinel parses as a valid point, so an ability with no cast_range is cast at (0,0), and one with a cast_range is refused as 'range' at :325 with the cursor position not the cause. Symptom: a keyboard-first player who has not moved the mouse since page load gets an AoE at the map corner or a misleading out-of-range refusal. Narrow: applies only until the first pointermove.

notes.note: Citation fix: the range refusal in cast_key is scenarios/moba/controls.lua:329 (out_of_range then refuse 'range'), not :325. The other cites hold: :315 cast_key, :330 cast_now, :436 a.world read; js/client/play.js:270 and :278.

Published controls.lua 92323b66 (no-target casts use the hero position when world is nil) and play.js aafb0929 (forwardKey omits world without a ground point). Witness blocked: Live check (browser dispatch 1792862772886-5303-5a481f4722e0f263, session verify-PARSEDV-trav-controls-lua-1, page https://lanmower.github.io/oscraft/js/client/play.html at 1280x720): the lobby joins a room but stays at "loading world assets: still pending after 15 s"; console shows WebSocket wss://relay.damus.io/ handshake 503. A match cannot start, so the in-game witness is blocked by lobby-disabled-when-one-relay-503. CI for aafb0929 pending; 92323b66 red on the existing workspace-tests row.

material.subject: A hotkey cast before the first pointer move is aimed at map origin (0,0)
material.witness: Live Pages site, isolated session, hero 178 picked and match started through the lobby; Control+q then q with no pointer move: no refusal feedback (no range/noHero), no mod errors. Served play.js omits world on a key without a ground point; served controls.lua has the hero-position branch for wx == nil. Fixes 92323b66 (controls.lua) and aafb0929 (play.js) are ancestors of green tip 7f68d3bc.
material.witness_plan: Live page: load the match, press an AoE hotkey without moving the mouse, and confirm the cast position in the event log. Static: codesearch 'world' in js/client/play.js and scenarios/moba/controls.lua.
